title: VESPER ImprovementIdea
description: REM-015. SR-044 authorises VESPER to research 'subjects or questions HE HAS' in free time. Before this contract, an idea arriving with no work in flight had nowhere to go: it was either acted on immediately (unvalidated, interrupting the work in hand) or lost. The backlog is runtime-owned and freely writable -- logging an idea about a governed surface is unrestricted. Maturing one into a change to a governed surface is not: it traverses the same proposal path as anything else (INV-IDEA-3).

thesis.description: What is believed, stated falsifiably where possible. A thesis that cannot be refuted cannot be investigated, only rehearsed.

provenance.description: INV-IDEA-1: what prompted it -- event ids, task ids, evidence refs. An idea with no provenance is a model prior wearing a plan's clothing.

target_surface.description: Subsystem or governed surface the change would touch. Null while unknown.

revisit_after.description: ISO-8601 duration. BOUNDED TUNABLE: VESPER may set this freely within the owner-declared range and may never alter the range itself (INV-TUNE-1). This is the 'time is relative' clause.

starvation_count.description: Increments each time an investigation was pre-empted by higher-priority work. Past starvation_count the trigger fires even when the system is not fully idle -- the owner's 'work that prevented it from doing it' clause.

supersedes.description: RB-029: a refined thesis records what it replaced. An objective may be refined by evidence; it may not silently become a different objective.

disposition_reason.description: MANDATORY on RETIRED (INV-IDEA-4). An entry that vanished without a reason is indistinguishable from one the system quietly gave up on.

allOf.$comment: INV-IDEA-4 -- nothing leaves the backlog silently.
INV-IDEA-3 -- a governed change is reached only through a proposal.
An investigated idea records what was tried, or the attempt is unauditable.
